tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms & conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Client list of the buyer, Past Supplies Orders and satisfactory performance certificate.

Tenderer supplied the Goods /Material(s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements at least Ten nos. to co-op/reputed dairy organizations in last five years. If yes, Valid documentary evidence for the same to be uploaded along with the technical bid (minimum 03 nos. performance certificates shall be provided with authentication).
Authorized Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) / Authorized Representative of a Manufacturer.
Tenderer has minimum of financial turnover not less than Rs.5 Crores in last 3 out of 5 financial years and whether uploaded turnover documents duly certified & signed by Chartered Accountant.
Detailed technical specifications provided by the DHAMUL duly Seal & signed by the authorized signatory.
TDS declaration form uploaded with seal and signature

Service centre at Karnataka state, If Yes: address, contact person, E-mail ID to be furnished (If service centre at Karnataka is not available then service centre within the range of 500 kms from Product dairy, DAMUL will be preferred).
Latest IT Returns and GSTR 3B monthly filed document
